author: IGN
description:
Kearush the Slayer is a mid-game boss fight in Crimson Desert that’s designed to kick your teeth in. While the giant ape was meant as a gift of peace to Hernand, Kearush quickly turns his sights on Kliff for what is easily one of the most punishing encounters in the game. If you’re struggling to survive the great ape’s relentless aggression and massive reach, we’ve got you covered with the essential strategies, phase breakdowns, and movement tips you need to walk away in one piece.

This Crimson Desert boss guide features a full walkthrough for the Kearush the Slayer fight, including tips on how to manage his three distinct phases. We break down the best skills to use, such as the Back Hang grappling technique, and explain why locking onto this particular boss is a must to keep the camera under control. Learn how to exploit Kearush’s blind spots, dodge his devastating ground slams, and manage your healing items to conquer one of the most challenging mid-game hurdles in Kliff's journey
title: Crimson Desert: How to Defeat Kearush the Slayer

author: IGN
description:
If you’ve rolled credits on the massive journey through Pywel and are wondering what’s left for Macduff and the Greymanes, we’ve got you covered. While Crimson Desert’s chunky main questline takes you across the breadth of the map, the end of the story is really just the beginning of your freedom. From wrapping up the emotional loose ends in the Epilogue questline to finally taking to the skies with your new dragon mount, we’re breaking down how to spend your final hours in one of the densest open worlds in years.

In this Crimson Desert post-game guide, we look at the faction quests, sealed abyss artifacts, and regional liberation mechanics that keep the world alive after the final boss. We'll explain how to access the Epilogue, why there is no New Game Plus (NG+), and how to master the Challenges tab in your journal to max out your ability trees. Whether you're hunting optional bosses or becoming the arm-wrestling champion of the world, here is everything you need to know about the
title: Crimson Desert Post-Game Guide: Endgame, NG+, and World Changes

author: IGN
description:
What better way to wait for the next Divinity game than to have its developers watch speedrunners break their work? In this video, five members of the Divinity: Original Sin 2 development team react to two amazing speedruns: a brain-breaking 7-minute run by Fazerer and a 35-minute glitchless run by Worldlyy. Check out real-time commentary from Larian Studios' David Walgrave (Head of Production), Edouard Imbert (Combat Design Lead), Farhang Namdar (World Building Director), Matthew Holland (Senior Combat Designer), and Nick Pechenin (Head of Design) as they have their minds blown by these incredible speedruns that push the game to its limits!

Check out more from these speedrunners!
